evidence.reason: Left edit removes metering.initialize() and changes plan argument from "monthly" to "benchmark", altering behavior that tests assert on (subscriptionCharge(40) > 0).
Right edit deletes usageCharge, which the dependency path shows is value-referenced by chargeUnit and which tests exercise via usageQuote(30, 0.1, "monthly").amount.
Dependency path indicates chargeUnit is referenced by both subscriptionCharge and usageCharge; removing usageCharge may break the backward reference chain.
